label: Schedule trigger
gloss: a clock fires at a set time and one run starts with no record from a source
why: Some work is not driven by an arrival but by a deadline. A schedule trigger starts one run at a set time; the record it emits carries only the run id, the day, and the time, and the run builds everything else from stores. At Beacon, the 2:30 PM run collects whatever the invoice flow put in the Payment Batch and delivers it before the 3:00 PM cutoff.
cue: if the question is "what did we collect today" rather than "what just arrived", the trigger is a clock, not an event
task: Start a run every day at 2:30 PM, with no inbox behind it.
notes: Mode: schedule; At: the time the clock fires.
The run record is { runId, scheduledAt, day } - no invoice fields. Later steps read the batch from a store.
One run per day, not one per record.

checks.label: The run record carries the day (day-1)
checks.why: a scheduled run has no invoice; it knows only when it fired
